title: Multiple Choice - Direct Questions
description: Choose the best answer for each question.

questions.text: Which phrase refers to leaving university or school before completing your studies?
What do we call an artist who creates drawings and digital models for animated movies?
Which term describes an extraordinary accomplishment that earns widespread praise?
What kind of medical facility is temporarily set up near a combat zone to treat wounded soldiers?
Which idiom describes a feeling of extreme happiness and elation?
What is a book recounting a real person's life history called?
Which adjective describes someone who has a strong desire to achieve great success or power?
What title is given to a courageous historical figure who fought to defend or liberate their nation?
What is the professional title of a doctor who specializes in performing surgical operations?
Which phrase refers to the mother and father who are genetically related to their child?
